# PRT012 `literal-kind-suffix`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A literal with a numeric kind suffix (`1.0_8`, `10_4`).

## Why

Numeric kind values are compiler-specific; suffix the literal with a named kind (`1.0_rk`).

## Reported

```fortran
x = 1.0_8
```

## Preferred

```fortran
x = 1.0_rk
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[PRT012] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = PRT012` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `PORT012` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
